claim_scope: causal dependence of the fixed LFM-plus-observer system under the specified intervention; not native LFM behavior or circuit causality

interventions.control: rank-2 random orthonormal planes, event-wise L2 matched
interventions.projector: rank-2 span of sealed S09 effective raw-coordinate pair normals

population.status: already revealed; mechanistic follow-up only, not independent confirmation

primary_contrast: mean random-control terminal target margin minus target-plane-ablation terminal target margin at strength 1.0; positive means selective target-plane damage
primary_outcome: paired target-vs-best-rival margin after intervention and frozen same-surface layer-16 S09 observer
review_decision: accept fixed observer endpoint, or define a separate native LFM answer-generation endpoint and baseline competence gate
uncertainty: shared whole-quartet bootstrap stratified by exact target; simultaneous intervals across six layer-by-surface contrasts
